inputs.expected_units_definition: observed assets x configuration count x preregistered validation windows x preregistered cost scenarios

max_candidates_per_asset.semantics: At most one candidate per asset is selected.

median_sharpe_gt_buyhold.semantics: Median of the per-fold strategy daily_sharpe values at baseline (1x) costs is greater than the median of the per-fold buy-and-hold daily_sharpe values of the same asset over the same fold windows at the same costs. The buy-and-hold baseline is recomputed from the frozen, hash-verified candle datasets; the result ledger itself contains no baseline field.

median_sharpe_gt_zero.semantics: Median of the per-fold daily_sharpe values at baseline (1x) costs is > 0. Folds without a defined Sharpe (no trades, constant equity) are excluded and the number of folds used is reported.

min_folds_with_min_trades.semantics: Number of validation folds whose baseline-cost trade_count reaches min_trades_per_fold.

min_trades_per_fold.semantics: Per-fold trade floor of min_trades_per_fold at baseline (1x) costs. README section 9 pairs this floor with min_folds_with_min_trades: 'at least 5 in at least three of the four folds', so the floor is required in min_folds_with_min_trades folds and not in every fold. The stricter reading (the floor in every fold) is evaluated as the sensitivity variant strict_min_trades_in_every_fold.

min_trades_total.semantics: Sum of trade_count over the four validation folds at baseline (1x) costs. Cost scenarios are the same trades re-costed, so they are not summed again.

neighbor_analysis.semantics: Parameter-neighbourhood stability analysis for the selected configuration: the mechanical neighbours (one dimension, one adjacent value), their net performance distribution, the share with positive validation returns and the median neighbour score. The specification defines no threshold, so this is reported and not used as a gate.

positive_folds_required.semantics: Number of validation folds with net_total_return > 0 at baseline (1x) costs.

positive_net_return_2x_costs.semantics: Mean of the four fold net_total_return values at 2x costs is > 0.

positive_net_return_baseline.semantics: Mean of the four fold net_total_return values at baseline (1x) costs is > 0. The preregistered wording is 'combined validation net return'; the mean and the sum of the fold returns share the same sign, so the gate is invariant to that choice.

ranking_metric.semantics: Descending median net daily Sharpe across the validation folds.

tiebreakers.input: result records: net_total_return, max_drawdown, turnover, config_id
tiebreakers.semantics: median_net_return (higher first), then max_drawdown (lower first; the worst fold drawdown), then turnover (lower first; the median fold turnover), then config_id (lexicographic ascending).
